About.headline: I didn't study graphic design. I studied film.
About.p1: Film taught me something most designers don't know: every image communicates something, whether you intend it or not. Emptiness communicates. Omission is a decision.
About.p2: Over time I understood that brands have the same problem. And solving it doesn't end with a logo — it ends with the systems that make that logo work in the real world.

FAQ.title: Questions Before Starting
FAQ.q1: Why do you talk about 'Visual Sovereignty' and not just logo design?
FAQ.a1: Because an isolated logo is just decoration. Visual Sovereignty is the construction of an intangible financial asset. I design complete systems based on archetypes and deep semiotics that allow your brand to stop competing on price and start leading through authority.
FAQ.q2: What level of involvement is required from the founder?
FAQ.a2: It requires deep collaboration during Phase 1 (Semiotic Diagnosis). My LogoCodex™ method doesn't work with generic forms; I need to extract the fundamental vision of the founders to encode it into the visual identity. Once this phase is complete, I take over technical and architectural control.
FAQ.q3: Do you work with any type of company or industry?
FAQ.a3: Yes. The LogoCodeX™ method doesn't depend on the industry — it depends on having something real to tell. I've worked with technology, services, gastronomy and more. What I do require is commitment to the process: if you're looking for quick design without depth, my way of working will feel excessive for that.
FAQ.q4: What exactly does the Phase 3 delivery include?
FAQ.a4: We don't deliver loose files. We deliver a functional ecosystem. This includes infinitely scalable vector versions, exact color systems, motion graphics ready for code implementation (React/Next.js), custom UI iconography, and an exhaustive Brand Manual that dictates the absolute rules of your new identity.
FAQ.q5: How do you integrate Artificial Intelligence into the process?
FAQ.a5: Through my 'Expanded Creativity' pillar. I use advanced AI models to accelerate diagnostics, generate complex iterations, and test applications in record time. However, art direction, semiotic strategy, and final vector refinement remain strictly under human control to guarantee absolute originality.

origin.title: The Origin of the Method
origin.p1Pre: LogoCodeX™ was born as a response to a crisis: the abundance of aesthetically correct but
origin.p2: The proliferation of generic templates has led many brands to differentiate only by color or typography, lacking a symbolic core capable of sustaining a long-term narrative.
origin.quote: The premise is radical: Your design must not only be attractive — it must activate a chain of cultural, emotional and narrative associations in collective memory.
origin.traditionalDesc: A static graphic element that identifies.
origin.li3Rest: It's a character in the brand's story.

pillars.title: The 3 Theoretical Pillars
pillars.p1Desc: We understand how signs work. We use the triadic model (Icon, Index, Symbol) and Barthes' levels (Denotation, Connotation, Myth) to ensure the message is read with the correct intention.
pillars.p2Desc: We connect with universal patterns of the collective unconscious. We define whether your brand is a "Hero", a "Creator" or a "Sage" to generate immediate and emotional identification.
pillars.p3Desc: We transform a graphic sign into a story. We ensure coherence between the symbol, the brand promise and its cultural context.
